name: Flow: Money Tracker
subtitle: Track money. Stay private.
short: Track money offline. No accounts, no ads, no data leaving your phone.
full:
Flow is a personal finance app that respects your privacy. Your money data stays on your device. No accounts, no ads, no analytics, no tracking.

WHY FLOW
Most finance apps read your transactions, sell your spending patterns and charge you every month. Flow doesn't. Everything works offline. The app is free and has no subscription.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Safe to spend: one number on Home that tells you what you can spend today and still finish the month on plan.
• Smart Add: type "12 coffee" and Flow suggests the category from the note, the places you have paid before and the time of day. Most entries take three taps.
• Bills and income: rent, subscriptions, salary. Plan shows what is coming, what is paid and what is left for the month.
• Budgets per category: a soft warning at 80%, a stop sign at 100%. Rollover supported.
• Goals and debts: see how far you are and when you will get there.
• Events and trips: give a trip or a party dates and a budget, and see what it really cost.
• Net worth: 24 months of history, down to every account.
• Insights: what changed against last month, income against spending, and an alert when a category jumps.
• Multi-currency: keep accounts in different currencies and see totals in the one you choose.
• Home screen widget: Safe to spend at a glance.
• Four colour themes, each in dark and light.
• 50 languages, with right-to-left layouts.
• A demo profile with two years of sample data, so you can explore before you add anything real.

FLOW PRO
An optional one-time purchase. No subscription: pay once and keep it. Flow Pro adds the Graphite, Ink and Espresso themes, larger widgets and the Quick add widget, Split (one total across several categories), monthly and yearly PDF reports, more than one live event and more than two profiles. Everything else in Flow is free.

PRIVACY
Your data is stored only on your device. No server, no login, no advertising network. The one optional connection fetches exchange rates once a day from a public service, and you can switch it off.

EXPORT
Export your full history as JSON or CSV at any time, and restore it on a new phone.

whatsNew:
Flow 1.3 brings home screen widgets, colour themes, Split and Flow Pro.

Widgets
• Safe to spend on your home screen in three sizes
• Quick add: your top three categories one tap away

Themes
• Mint, Graphite, Ink and Espresso, each in dark and light. Find them in Settings, Theme

Split
• Enter one total and spread it across several categories

Flow Pro
• An optional one-time purchase, no subscription. It unlocks the Graphite, Ink and Espresso themes, the larger widgets, Quick add, Split, PDF reports, more than one live event and more than two profiles
• Everything else stays free. If you already use Flow, events and PDF reports stay free for you

Also new
• Events and trips: dates, an optional budget, and what it really cost
• Plan browses any month and pays bills ahead as scheduled transactions
• Activity shows every category used this month as a filter
• 80 icons for categories, 33 for accounts, and your own tab order

Fixes
• Tap outside a field to close the keyboard, on every screen and sheet
• The date picker no longer closes before you can pick a day
• Restoring a backup keeps your own categories
• Dragging accounts to reorder works again
